en.title: Minimum Days Reading k Consecutive Chapters per Day
en.description:
Each day, choose exactly k consecutive chapters and read at most p pages of each chosen chapter (a chapter with fewer than p pages left is simply finished). Chapters may be chosen repeatedly, and a finished chapter can still be chosen. Find the minimum number of days needed to finish every chapter.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n k p; the second line contains the page count of each chapter. 1≤n≤100000, 1≤k≤n, 1≤p,pages≤10^9.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: Example 1: choose the first two chapters twice and the last two chapters twice, 4 days in total. Example 2: each of the two chapters needs 2 days and they cannot be read on the same day, so the answer is 4. Example 3: one selection covers everything and p is large enough, so the answer is 1.
hints: Each chapter needs ceil(pages/p) coverings. Scan from left to right; when a chapter is still short, pick the valid k-chapter window that covers it and lies as far right as possible, and make up the shortfall in one batch.
